sign-in.alt: The Pi Durable Platform sign-in page of the Example Corp Agents instance: the instance name and a card with the button "Sign in with single sign-on".

home.alt: Home for Sam Ortiz: "Your teams" listing Support (owner) and Data Platform (editor), with the sidebar's Home, All agents and Catalog, the team switcher and Sam's name at the bottom.

all-agents.alt: All agents: a table of agents from Sam's teams and personal workspace (name, team, template, model, status, last used), a search box and the "Deploy agent" button.

catalog.alt: The Catalog: platform templates and published team templates as a list with name, owner and description, including Assistant and Helpdesk triage (from the Support team).

deploy-dialog.alt: The "Deploy Helpdesk triage" dialog: Team set to Support, Name "Helpdesk assistant", an optional description, Model on "Template's model", and the "Deploy agent" button.

agent-overview.alt: The Overview tab of the Helpdesk assistant agent: status (hibernated), template and version, model, tools from two MCP servers, storage, usage over the last 30 days, and the "Use it from your app" card with curl examples.

agent-test-chat.alt: The Test tab of Helpdesk assistant: the list of chats on the left with "New chat", and an open conversation with a user message and a streamed reply, a tool call and the line with model, tokens and time under the reply.

test-chat-private.alt: A new chat on a team agent's Test tab: the Shared and Private toggle above the message box, Private chosen, with the hint "Only you".

agent-settings.alt: The Settings tab of an agent: name, description, the Model picker on "Template's model", the "Turn off agent" section and the Delete this agent section.

personal-workspace.alt: Sam Ortiz's personal workspace Overview: "Your own workspace: deploy agents from the catalog and use them on your own.", with the Limits card showing 1 of 5 agents and 0 of 2 running.

api-keys.alt: Account › API keys: a table of Sam's personal keys (name, created, expires, last used) with the "Create API key" button.

api-key-created.alt: The "API key created" notice after creating a key named "Deploy script on my laptop": the secret starting with pdp_ in a copy field and "Copy this key now."

consent-page.alt: The OAuth Connect approval page for "Example Corp Chat" (chat.example.com): "See your agents and chat with them", "Create agents in teams where you can", and the Allow and Deny buttons.

connected-apps.alt: Account › Connected apps: Example Corp Chat, verified by chat.example.com, connected and last used dates, with "Disconnect…" on its row.

team-overview.alt: The Support team's Overview: Sam's role (Owner), the owners, admins and editors, Recent changes from the audit log, and the team's limits.

team-members.alt: Team settings › Members for Support: members with their roles, the "Add member" button, and one open invite.

team-templates.alt: The Support team's Templates page: Helpdesk triage (published) and Release notes writer (private), with the "New template" button.

template-versions.alt: The Versions tab of Helpdesk triage: versions 3, 2 and 1 with their notes, model and date, and the "New version" button.

template-submit.alt: A team template waiting for review: the "Waiting for review" notice and the "Withdraw the request" action on its page.

team-models.alt: The Support team's Models page, Models tab: platform models published to the team and one of the team's own, marked as the team's.

team-provider-add.alt: The "Add provider" dialog on a team's Models › Providers tab: type, name, an https base URL on the company network, the API key and extra headers.

team-mcp-servers.alt: The Support team's MCP servers page, Available tab: the team's own Ticket search server listed first, then platform servers published to the team.

service-accounts.alt: The Support team's Service accounts: helpdesk-chat (editor, enabled, last used today) and reports-bot (member), with "Create service account".

service-account-key-created.alt: The "Key created" notice for the helpdesk-chat service account: the secret starting with pdp_sa_, "Copy this key now." and "Next: finish the rotation".

team-usage.alt: The Support team's Usage page: period, Group by Agent, a chart of tokens per day and a table of requests, tokens and estimated cost per agent.

team-audit.alt: Team settings › Audit log for Support: entries such as "Deployed agent", "Created service account key" and "Read a private conversation", with Action and Person filters and Hide sign-ins.

admin-users.alt: Admin › Users: a table of people (name, email, platform role, status, teams, last sign-in) with the admin sidebar groups People and Records, and Settings.

admin-user-detail.alt: Admin › Users › Jordan Lee: profile and groups from the identity provider, platform role, teams and roles, connected apps, and the Suspend… action.

admin-teams.alt: Admin › Teams: teams and personal workspaces with their kind, owners and status, filtered to show both kinds, and the "Create team" button.

admin-create-team.alt: The "Create team" dialog: name Data Platform, slug data-platform, a description, and the first owner's email.

admin-personal-workspace.alt: Admin › Teams › a personal workspace's Overview: its owner, agents and running agents against its limits, and the "Audit this workspace" card.

admin-templates-review.alt: Admin › Templates: the review queue with Release notes writer from the Data Platform team waiting for review, then every template.

admin-review-dialog.alt: The review dialog for a team template: Approve and Reject, with the "Note to the team" field required to reject.

admin-models-providers.alt: Admin › Models, Providers tab: two providers (an Anthropic-compatible gateway and an OpenAI-compatible one), their type, access mode and model count, with the Owner filter and "Add provider".

admin-provider-models.alt: A provider's Models tab with the "Discover models" list: models the provider offers, some already added, checkboxes to add others.

admin-model-edit.alt: The "Edit model" form: name, context window, max output tokens, Accepts images, Reasoning, input and output price per million tokens, and "Who may use it" with All teams and Personal workspaces.

admin-mcp-servers.alt: Admin › MCP servers: platform servers and one team's own (Owner filter on All owners), with access mode, who may use it and tool count, and "Add MCP server".

admin-mcp-server-tools.alt: An MCP server's Tools tab: its tools with their descriptions, the last time they were read, and "Refresh tools".

admin-settings.alt: Admin › Settings: the Personal workspaces section (switches, Max agents 5, Max running at once 2, Monthly budget) and Team providers and MCP servers with Private networks.

admin-trusted-apps.alt: Admin › Settings › Trusted apps: one app, Example Corp Chat, with its client ID https://chat.example.com/oauth/client-metadata.json and a label.

admin-usage.alt: Admin › Usage: usage across teams grouped by Team, with requests, tokens and estimated cost per team over the last 30 days.

admin-audit.alt: Admin › Audit log: recent entries across the platform with actor, how they acted, action and target, the filters and "Export CSV".

agent-conversations-tab.alt: An agent's Conversations tab as a platform admin: every thread with its visibility, who started it and its last activity; private titles shown as "Title hidden", and "Read conversation".

read-conversation-dialog.alt: The "Read conversation" dialog: a required reason field (10 to 500 characters) and a note that the read is recorded in the team's audit log for its owners to see.
